data.one_liner: Fast algorithm to find a polygon's pole of inaccessibility for optimal label placement
data.what_it_does: Polylabel computes the point inside a polygon that is farthest from its edges, returning that point and its distance. It is useful for placing text labels or markers centrally within irregular shapes.
use_when: You need to place a label or marker at the most central point of a polygon
You want a fast, pure Dart implementation without external dependencies
avoid_when: You need a full GIS library or advanced spatial queries
You require integration with Flutter widgets or UI components
strengths: Pure Dart, no native code or platform-specific dependencies
weaknesses: Only supports 2D polygons, no 3D or complex geometry support
